locations: Gledholt Methodist Church, 30 Edgerton Grove Road, Marsh, Huddersfield, HD1 5QX
eligibility: Economically inactive (not working and not looking for work)
referralRoutes: Email info@shapingcarekirklees.org or phone 07597 122074 (contact: Griffith Gay)

activities.name: Shaping Healthy Working Life
activities.summary: Practical support to overcome challenges, rebuild daily routines and boost confidence, connecting people with local providers, voluntary groups and activities to prepare for volunteering, work or study.
